items: Once you run several locations, reviews scatter across Google, delivery apps and other platforms, so you need one place to monitor and answer them all.
Replying to more reviews tends to lift your average rating, and a higher visible rating makes guests more likely to choose your restaurant.
When you compare tools, check review coverage, sentiment analysis, multi-location dashboards, alerts, and integrations with your POS, reservations and loyalty systems.
After rollout, track review volume, average rating, response rate, response time, sentiment and location performance to see whether the software is working.
Momos brings reviews, social, surveys and delivery feedback into one Unified Inbox, drafts on-brand replies with AI and shows which locations need attention.
